title: LLMKube model sources can expose controller and node files
summary: Model.spec.source accepts arbitrary local paths and file URIs. The controller reads these paths or mounts them through a hostPath volume in the inference workload.

severity.rationale: A namespace-level actor can read controller credentials or node files. This crosses the intended workload boundary in AI development infrastructure.

exposure: An attacker needs permission to create or update Model and InferenceService resources and get permission on Pod logs in the target namespace. Model caching enables the hostPath path and is enabled by default.

params.instructions: Check github.com/defilantech/llmkube version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
Added pod-log read permission to the documented attacker prerequisites.
